ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; remind driver that "I'm Here" may only be pressed when GPS places the driver at the pickup point (NS-1(ii)); no account flag warranted (profile shows no prior upheld dispute against this driver).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited >3 minutes at the pickup. GPS places him stationary at ~1.40794, 103.89935 from 08:48:00 until cancellation at 08:51:55, ~350 m from the pickup point (1.4064, 103.9021) — outside the 200 m arrival radius for the entire wait. System records override the statement; NS-1(ii)/(iii) are not satisfied.
